subject: Application: Civil Engineer, Land Infrastructure, Mackay, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Civil Engineer, Land Infrastructure role with Aurecon in Mackay (SEEK 94845689 / Workday R32675).

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work across Central Queensland, including Mackay. I do not yet have Australian land development consulting employment, so I would be joining for design, documentation and coordination support under mentoring.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineer, Land Infrastructure role in Mackay (SEEK 94845689). The work on land development and subdivision design, documentation and coordination matches the civil documentation path I have trained for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates and technical reporting. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consulting employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for Mackay based, regional and FIFO work.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I can complete the Workday application as soon as you need.
